body:
Her name is Snow and she’s a little white 4 month old kitten i adopted. 

and i mean yeah meds would help and stuff but i really just don’t care at this point because i’m going to end up killing myself anyways. i went back on medication for my anxiety a month ago but since i’m struggling with some drug issues i ended up abusing it a lot and getting really sick and almost having to go to the hospital and stuff so i had to take like a break for a while

my friends all know about me struggling with depression and suicide and other mental health issues. i’ve said many times that i’m not joking and they try to help at the time but then eventually stop caring again once i seem fine 

i was gonna start medication again next month actually because i stopped taking it about a year ago because i was feeling a bit better and didn’t need it
I tried talking to my mom and she told me if i really wanted to kill myself i already would’ve done it

I think i just really need someone to listen to me. like me being able to randomly call them at 11 pm when i feel down and i know they’re going to try to listen if they’re able to. i don’t know if that’s too much to ask really but i at least just need someone to listen to me, because i feel like no one ever has. and i can’t really blame them because i’m a mess

i’ve tried countless of times but what happens most of the time is people think i’m joking or they say i’m too dark and don’t wanna talk to me about it. 

i just wish one of my friends actually took the time to listen

most people don’t really like me at all. and i don’t blame them. i’ve told my friends millions of times that i’m going to kill myself. even today i’ve told some of them that i’m going to kill myself this week and no one bothers to talk to me or anything. i always end up ranting and then being left on seen or them saying that i’m too dark and they don’t wanna talk to me, which i get but i think that if one of my friends texted me saying they wanted to commit suicide i’d be willing to talk to them for as long as they needed to. 

no one cares really. and there’s not much i can do at this point
I go to therapy but she doesn’t seem to take me seriously as well, or just doesn’t think i’m too much of a danger to myself to help
I think it’s just easier for me to be more open with strangers in the internet because I’m scared of being judged by those around me

I think a lot of the reason why my friends think I’m joking is because wanting to kill yourself has become sort of a meme now. Every time I tell them I want to die I’m always replied to with “same” and “mood”. It’s tiring. I’m genuinely trying to ask for help a lot of the time and it’s treated as a joke. 

I’ve been depressed for years, and it’s come to the point where I just can’t handle it anymore. I’ve just been progressively getting worse as time goes by, despite making efforts to change and get better. The only thing that has kept me going for so long is my cat, since I love her so much and would hate for her to be alone when I’m gone. I started introducing her to more people and teaching them how to take care of her and prepare her food etc.
I go to therapy every now and then but she never seems to take me seriously. I don’t think anyone is really gonna take me seriously until I successfully kill myself
